name: Apex Legends — Performance
description: Keeps Apex Legends on the performance cores with High priority, the high-performance GPU and the High performance power plan for the match. Browsers and downloaders are deprioritised while voice chat stays usable.
notes: The power-plan switch is session-scoped: the exact plan that was active before the game is restored when the session ends, including after a crash.
Browsers are lowered to Idle, not suspended, so downloads and tabs survive the match.
Discord stays at BelowNormal so a party call remains responsive.
Apex uses the Source engine and UDP game traffic; no TCP-only network values are applied.
Thermal guard: above 90°C CPU or 87°C GPU the profile releases and waits 3 minutes before re-applying.
